decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed new shop front by reason of size, materials and design is considered to comply with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.2 (Shop front design) of Council Unitary Development Plan, 2003 as well as Fact Sheet 5.1 and 5.2 (Entrance doors and Lobbies) of the Council's Think Access:  Design for Accessibility, April 2000 and Shop Fronts:  General Design and Town Planning Guidelines, April 1992.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Installation of a new shopfront and erection of a canopy to front of existing Public House.
